mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM t_extraction_post_stage s JOIN t_document d ON d.id=s.document_id WHERE s.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND s.next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.extraction_summary_json,'$.runId'))=s.run_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_extraction_post_stage prior WHERE prior.document_id=s.document_id AND prior.run_id=s.run_id AND prior.id<s.id AND prior.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED')) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT s.* FROM t_extraction_post_stage s JOIN t_document d ON d.id=s.document_id WHERE s.run_id=#{runId} AND s.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND s.next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.extraction_summary_json,'$.runId'))=s.run_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_extraction_post_stage prior WHERE prior.document_id=s.document_id AND prior.run_id=s.run_id AND prior.id<s.id AND prior.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED')) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_extraction_post_stage SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{workerId},locked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE t_extraction_post_stage SET status='SUCCEEDED',last_error=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_extraction_post_stage SET status='SKIPPED',last_error=#{reason},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING')

UPDATE t_extraction_post_stage SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_extraction_post_stage WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_extraction_post_stage SET status='PENDING',attempt_count=0,manual_replay_count=manual_replay_count+1,last_error=NULL, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('RETRY','DEAD')
